---
name: "Feature request or user feedback"
about: "Suggest a concrete feature or clarify a workflow, setup step or research explanation."
title: "[Feedback] "
---

This issue is public. Use synthetic examples and omit credentials, customer
information, private images, weights, sensitive logs, personal paths and contact
information. Do not post exploit details. Follow
[SECURITY.md](https://github.com/GiannisPap24/factoryvision-ai/blob/main/SECURITY.md)
for suspected security problems; choose **Report a vulnerability** on Advisories.

## Type of feedback

- [ ] Feature request
- [ ] Workflow/usability feedback
- [ ] Documentation or research-explanation feedback

## What were you trying to understand or do?

Name the workspace or link the documentation section. Include the source commit
if known, and say whether this was the synthetic demo or a local research workflow.

## Where did the explanation or workflow become unclear?

Describe the expectation and what you encountered. For scientific wording, quote
only the short relevant passage and explain the interpretation it suggested.

## Suggested improvement

What change would make the task or limitation clearer?

## Before submitting

- [ ] My feedback contains no sensitive data or third-party sample imagery.
- [ ] I understand synthetic output is not real inference or model performance.
- [ ] This feedback is not a ground-truth label or an industrial acceptance decision.
